title: LZ4 frame signature
summary: An LZ4 frame begins with the 4-byte magic 0x04 0x22 0x4D 0x18 (little-endian: 0x184D2204).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: LZ4 is an extremely fast compression algorithm.
Used by ZFS, Linux kernel, Hadoop, and many databases.
